subject: Upcoming Family Reunion Details
body: Dear family members, We are excited to announce that the upcoming family reunion will be held on July 15th at the Smith Family Park. The event will start at 10:00 AM with a potluck lunch, games, and activities for all ages. Please RSVP by July 1st to confirm your attendance and let us know what dish you will be bringing. We can't wait to see everyone and catch up with each other! Best regards, The Smith Family
